verse.text: Care for the flock that God has entrusted to you. Watch over it willingly, not grudgingly—not for what you will get out of it, but because you are eager to serve God. Don't lord it over the people assigned to your care, but lead them by your own good example.

video.title: Our Trustworthy Father | Our Daily Bread Devotional

reflection: Being a dad isn't about running your home like a boss barking orders—it's about showing up daily, willingly, because you love the people God gave you to care for. Kids don't follow perfect speeches; they follow the example you live out when you're tired, stressed, or just doing the dishes. Lead your family the way a good shepherd leads sheep: close enough to guide, humble enough to serve.
